title: RAW one planet has carried and proper motions with distinct causes, periods and nested circle relations
summary: RAW UNREVIEWED, not selected, executed or novelty-certified. Complete Steele chapter I id00108 assigns opposite directions to the same planet under carried versus proper motion, then distinguishes natural first/second motions and circle-relative direct/retrograde/stationary states. A prospective full-paragraph synopsis must preserve motion owner, cause, period and circle scope, together with all seven numerical entries, cosmological consequences and textual tensions; it is not a wind or season label map.

design.mechanism: One referent can have distinct attributed motions when cause and mode remain attached: the firmament carries the planet in one direction, whereas its own motion is described in the contrary direction. Each description brings its own period or circle restrictions. The later first/second division is nested within natural motion; the epicycle states use another explicitly stated circle-relative position. The proposed content binds those relations instead of treating every direction or first/second as one undifferentiated property.
design.positive_consequence: A synopsis that retains opposite-direction labels but swaps the carrier and the carried body, attaches daily ravishing to the proper completed circuit, or makes natural first/second equal the top-level carried/proper pair changes the source claim. Likewise, direct/retrograde/stationary must retain upper/lower/middle epicycle ownership. Mere shared planet, circle and direction names cannot satisfy these restrictions. These are source-side content consequences, not observed target matches.
design.prospective_distinguishing_observation: A future complete synopsis would need to express both direction/cause statements for the same planet while independently keeping the seven proper-course entries and the nested circle relations. Explicitly wrong cause, temporal owner, nesting or epicycle position would distinguish the rival even if all planet and direction labels were present. No target observation was made in this pass.
serious_rivals: Direction words might denote sequential reversal of one motion. The source instead distinguishes carried and proper modes; it does not itself provide a modern net-motion calculation.

The passage may function as a catalogue of received astronomical doctrines rather than one formally unified motion model. Its joins, numerical tensions and editorial ellipsis may prevent a coherent exact synopsis under a later fixed contract.
The later first/second motion and epicycle classifications may not align cleanly with an imposed hierarchical formalism. Retain the wording and uncertainty rather than repairing it.

Existing498/503 coupled-motion proposals may already own a closely related semantic construction. Their target-bearing primary payloads were not opened in this source-only pass; this RAW makes no novelty claim.
whole_source_duties: The same planets receive two top-level motions: proper/natural west-to-east against the firmament, and carried east-to-west through the firmament. The latter is explicitly daily and attributed to violence/ravishing.

Proper courses take unequal times; the source connects this with greater and smaller courses. Retain all seven sign-stays and completed-course periods exactly as printed, including apparent numerical tensions and the unglossed bisse.

Entry and exit of seven stars among twelve signs vary generation/corruption in the lower world. Preserve the attributed Mesalath quotation, stationary earth, moving elements and helping stars without modernizing their syntax or cosmology.

The account assigns inclination and destruction to planetary working and distinguishes its effects by climates/countries. These effects are not a direction-conversion rule. Preserve the anthology ellipsis after Slavens.

After restating carried motion, the source divides natural motion into first and second. The first stays within its own circle; the second is under the zodiac and passes like space in like time. These nested divisions are not one flat two-item classification.

The first own circle is called eccentric because earth is not its centre, contrasted with the zodiac circle. The epicycle is described as a little circle traversed by the planet. No heliocentric reinterpretation or modern vector addition is licensed.

Retain the qualified or awkward first alike swift wording and diverse circles. Direct, retrograde and stationary/hovering motions are explicitly placed in upper, lower and middle epicycle parts respectively. Do not silently resolve the relation between these descriptions and all earlier motions.
